pos.personaBrief: PSG averaged 64.6% possession and Luis Enrique says 'we prefer to keep the ball', yet he accepts adapting and defending when opponents force it; the team also scores incisive counters.

pro.personaBrief: Build-up is patient with a back three, a free man and short passing against the press (Coaches' Voice, El Buen Fútbol), with Vitinha as line-breaking pivot; long balls to wings are only an occasional tool.

est.personaBrief: Jeu de position 2.0 with 4-2-4, 3-2-2-3 and 3-1-2-2-2-0, but fluid rotations, a faux 9 and no fixed individual reference points: structure by principles, not fixed zones; wingers cut inside and the striker drops.

lar.personaBrief: Wingers are wide but cut inside, Hakimi goes inside or high, and the final shows minimal overlaps and numbers centrally; width exists but the play concentrates centrally.

blo.personaBrief: High man-oriented press from the front three, forwards as first defenders, free centre-backs stepping up to duel (Coaches' Voice, El Buen Fútbol), offside trap; never a low block.

mar.personaBrief: Pressing is player-to-player (Doué on Bastoni, Fabián on Calhanoglu), but set-piece defence is mixed zone with four free players; man-orientation in open play, no dedicated star-marker evidence.

pla.personaBrief: Strong imposed model with its own principles every game, but shape and pressing details change with the opponent (4-2-4 vs 3-2-2-3, Arsenal adaptation, 'you have to adapt'); he does not abandon his idea against stronger teams.

res.personaBrief: Wins big while playing proactively; a 5-0 final, attacking away at City and Barcelona; spectacle and result are tied, he keeps going for goals rather than shutting games.

sis.personaBrief: Stars serve the team 'and not the other way round'; Dembele was dropped for lateness, everyone presses, tactical roles are defined though rotating; talent is signed but fitted into the system.

jog.personaBrief: Signs technically gifted, two-footed players (Vitinha, Neves, Doue) while also checking physical data; intensity is a basic requirement of the press, but technique prevails.

bas.personaBrief: Youngest squad in the last 16, 19-year-olds Doue, Neves and Mayulu decisive in the final, long-term signings and opportunities for the young when ready, but built mostly through signings.

lid.personaBrief: Dembele left out of the Arsenal squad for lateness, stars follow the same rules, the coach decides; yet he manages pressure and rests players, with a united group, without negotiating the line-up.
